collection.title: Skoda Praktik 2007 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Skoda Praktik 2007 to 2015 will fit, this model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Skoda Praktik which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
